Sugar-free ice cream - you didn't mention the name of the substitute, but we have had very good results using Allulose. Less sweet than sugar, but sweet enough for my diabetic husband.
Vegan ice cream -  we use coconut cream instead of cream/milk. The texture is fine and there's no coconut taste.

comments.text:
Hey Nick, how do u determine the fat in cocoa powder if I have 3 sources of fat in this recipe? Cream and milk is assumed as 9% what would be then for CP since it does not derive from milk.

m learning how to use simultaneous equation to determine each composition (%) as a backup just in case 😅
comments.author: @fattmeows8868

comments.text:
You have to add the CP fat to the total fat number but do a separate calculation for the MSNF. Fat is fat as far as the overall number is concerned but the MSNF should be somewhere between 8-12%. 
Chocolate bases are notorious for being hard as the additional fats and solids are not calculated correctly.  
Total fat for ice cream should be 12% and higher with MSNF in the 8-12% range. 
Less than 12% total fat and you’re getting in to gelato territory.
